name: scattering-level Blaschke control
definition: M_B(z) = [xi(z)/xi(z+1)] * prod_j (z - a_j)(z - conj a_j)/((z + a_j)(z + conj a_j)), Re a_j > 0, Im a_j != 0. Equivalently f(z)/f(z+1) with f = xi(z) prod_j Gamma(z + a_j)Gamma(z + conj a_j)/(Gamma(z - a_j)Gamma(z - conj a_j)).
has: every p-adic local factor of zeta
holomorphic in Re z > 0 off z = 1
Maass-Selberg positivity for every T >= 1 (proved, Theorem C of the lane)
a zero at each prescribed a_j, anywhere in the open right half-plane
lacks: a vector at the archimedean place of a group representation
the relation f(z) = f(1 - z) for f itself
use: kills any argument on an Eisenstein/scattering carrier that uses only the cocycle relation, unitarity, holomorphy in the positive chamber and positivity of truncated norms
status: proved in rank one; author referee pass only
